description: Main module implementing batch operations for the Litellm library, including creation, retrieval, listing, cancellation, and handling of async invoke status for batches across multiple providers (OpenAI, Azure, Vertex AI, Bedrock, etc.). It contains functions for synchronous and asynchronous batch management, including provider-specific handling and special async invoke status processing for AWS Bedrock.
